title_en: Semantic models, measures and the report
how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: CH-15..CH-20 zigzag and CH-17 before CH-23 (ADR-001): open and close with callbacks that re-establish where we are on the A-01 map and name the chapter we return to.

sentences.ar: الـchart هو آخر خمسة في الميّة من الشغل.
sentences.en: A chart is the last five percent of the work.

sentences.ar: وكل اللي بيخليه موثوق قاعد وراه في الـmodel.
sentences.en: Everything that makes it trustworthy sits behind it in the model.

sentences.ar: والـmeasure مش عمود دي دالة بتتقيّم على الصفوف اللي عاشت في سياق الفلتر الحالي.
sentences.en: A measure is not a column — it is a function evaluated against whatever rows survive the current filter context.

sentences.ar: بصّ: نفس الـmeasure بترجّع رقم مختلف تحت كل slicer، وما اتغيّرش حاجة في المعادلة.
sentences.en: Watch: the same measure returns a different number under each slicer, and nothing about the formula changed.

sentences.ar: وده سبب إن النسبة من الإجمالي بتبوظ أول مرة تكتبها: المقام بيتفلتر مع البسط، فبترجّع ميّة في الميّة على طول.
sentences.en: That is why percentage-of-total breaks the first time you write it: the denominator is being filtered along with the numerator, so it always returns one hundred percent.

sentences.ar: وبتشتغل صح لما المقام يتجاهل الفلتر عن قصد.
sentences.en: It works when the denominator deliberately ignores the filter.

sentences.ar: والـtime intelligence نفس الفخ بلبس تاني
sentences.en: Time intelligence is the same trap in a different costume

sentences.ar: حساب same-period-last-year بيستبدل فلتر التاريخ مش بيضيّقه، ولو ما تعرفش كده، مقارنة السنة بالسنة بتاعتك بتقارن فترة بنفسها في الهدوء.
sentences.en: a same-period-last-year calculation replaces the date filter rather than narrowing it, and if you do not know that, your year-over-year comparison is quietly comparing a period with itself.

sentences.ar: والانضباط الأهم هنا هو تعريف واحد لكل KPI، متعرّف مرة في الـmodel ومعاد استخدامه، بدل نفس المعادلة متكتوبة بشكل مختلف شوية في أربع dashboards.
sentences.en: The discipline that matters most here is one definition per KPI, defined once in the model and reused, instead of the same formula retyped slightly differently in four dashboards.

sentences.ar: والتقرير نفسه: اختار الـencoding من السؤال، مش من قائمة الرسوم.
sentences.en: And the report itself: choose the encoding from the question, not from the chart menu.

sentences.ar: الموضع للمقارنة، والطول للمقدار، واللون للفئة وأبداً مش للكمية.
sentences.en: Position for comparison, length for magnitude, colour for category and never for quantity.

sentences.ar: وافحص التباين بالمعادلة الحقيقية، مش بالعين الزوج ده بيقيس واحد وعشرين لواحد، وعدد مفاجئ من ألوان الشركات بيقيس تحت تلاتة.
sentences.en: Check the contrast with the real formula, not by eye — this pairing measures twenty-one to one, and a surprising number of corporate palettes measure below three.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A calculation defined once and evaluated against whichever rows survive the current filter context, so its result changes with the filter.
concepts.def_ar: معادلة بتتعرّف مرة واحدة وبتتحسب على الـrows اللي فاضلة بعد الـfilter context الحالي، فنتيجتها بتتغير مع الفلتر.
concepts.failure: Treating a measure like a stored column; it recalculates differently under each filter.

concepts.def_en: One named attribute of a table with a fixed data type shared by every row.
concepts.def_ar: الـcolumn خاصية واحدة ليها اسم في الجدول وبنفس الـdata type لكل الصفوف.
concepts.failure: Storing several values in one column, which breaks first normal form.

concepts.def_en: A named, reusable block of code that takes inputs, does a calculation and returns a value.
concepts.failure: Forgetting return, so the function silently gives back None.

concepts.def_en: The set of filters currently active in a report; a measure is evaluated only against the rows that survive them.
concepts.def_ar: مجموعة الفلاتر الشغالة دلوقتي في التقرير؛ والـmeasure بيتحسب على الصفوف اللي عايشة تحتها بس.
concepts.failure: Reading a total as global when slicers have already filtered the rows behind it.

concepts.def_en: Dashboard functions comparing periods, such as Same Period Last Year or year-over-year growth; they silently return wrong numbers when filters or the calendar are wrong.
concepts.def_ar: دوال في الـdashboard بتقارن الفترات، زي نفس الفترة السنة اللي فاتت ونمو سنة بسنة، وبتطلّع أرقام غلط لو التقويم أو الـfilters مش مظبوطة.
concepts.failure: Using Same Period Last Year without a complete date table gives silently wrong comparisons.

concepts.def_en: Key Performance Indicator: a business metric chosen to track progress toward a goal, defined once and reused across dashboards.
concepts.def_ar: الـKPI (Key Performance Indicator) مقياس بيزنس بنتابع بيه التقدم ناحية هدف، ومعرّف مرة واحدة ويتعاد استخدامه في كل الـdashboards.
concepts.failure: Redefining the same KPI slightly differently in several dashboards, so numbers disagree.

concepts.def_en: The agreed mapping between bytes and characters, so the same bytes display as the right t…
concepts.failure: Reading a file with the wrong encoding, producing garbled Arabic characters.

prediction or parameter the viewer controls

metaphors.metaphor: 3D star schema; a measure computes live; report accessibility check (§6.13)
metaphors.beats: Fact table at centre, dimensions orbit

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
A fact table with dimension tables in 3D.
A panel of 1-6 KPIs with status colours.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
